title: Meta validation, claims, checkpoints, lineage and the learned-record authority boundary (NF-1T)
note: NU1-NU22: a meta validation that allocates, a development run credited to the flagship or a large model, an interrupted run counted as trained, a tampered report accepted, a learned record made authority live or on replay or by the second reader, a broken lineage link accepted, a checkpoint's bytes or tensors unchecked, resume semantics conflated, the learned-prediction semantics dropped, a legacy import or machine-mode name planted in the substrate.
